name: Container privilege guard
summary: Block explicit container privilege expansion in commands and recognized deployment configuration.
description: A deterministic Claude Code PreToolUse gate that detects privileged mode, host namespaces, dangerous capabilities, engine socket mounts, and device passthrough in container commands and recognized configuration paths.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks explicit container privilege expansion in commands and recognized deployment configuration; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not run containers or inspect a live container engine.
It does not claim to validate every Kubernetes security control.
It does not accept a manifest annotation or environment variable as approval.

entrypoints.purpose: Detect explicit high-impact host privileges in container commands and proposed configuration.

linkReasons.hook/security/application-security/shell: container-privilege-guard cannot see hidden commands (e.g. bash -c "$X"): shell-command-guard stops them.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block explicit container privilege expansion in commands and recognized deployment configuration without deferred work.
